svg.title: Who patches what?
svg.desc: Layered diagram showing a web stack divided into application layer at top, PHP runtime in the middle marked as the flaw location, and infrastructure at the bottom. A WAF is shown upstream to the right. Annotations show that a WordPress update reaches only Zone 1, while a PHP patch applies to Zone 2 by the host or sysadmin. A dashed boundary line marks where site-owner patch access ends.

text.tspan: ◂ site owner's patch access ends here ▸
Patched by: hosting provider / sysadmin / platform —
PHP 8.1 and older: no upstream fix
Sources: PHP advisory (php.net, 21 Oct 2026); AWS security bulletin 2026-143-AWS; Cloudflare WAF blog
